name: adarkroom-realm
description: 从暗室到领邦 — A Dark Room with settlement expansion and Cloudflare cloud saves

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: 保存账号、游戏进度与最近 5 次存档备份。部署时自动创建 D1 数据库。
